items.name: resource-amber
items.subject: AMBER, the main resource: a compact cluster of three big smooth, glossy, translucent honey-orange amber nuggets, warm light inside them, one bright highlight on each.

items.name: resource-substance
items.subject: SUBSTANCE, the forest's raw magic: one big round drop of luminous violet LIQUID light, glossy like a bead of water, a bright white highlight at its upper left. A liquid, never a crystal.

items.name: deposit-amber
items.subject: AN AMBER DEPOSIT, the node workers mine: a low heap of big glossy, translucent honey-orange amber nuggets bulging out of a dark gnarled root, glowing warmly from within.

items.name: deposit-substance
items.subject: A SUBSTANCE DEPOSIT: a split in a dark gnarled old root where luminous violet LIQUID wells up into a small round glowing pool, a few drops rising above it. A liquid, never crystals.
